description: This file implements a React component using Remix framework to handle note viewing, creation, updating, and deletion in a simple notes app. It includes loader and action functions for server interactions and a React component for the UI.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loads the current note ID from URL parameters for hydration on client side.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submissions for creating, updating, or deleting notes based on form intent.

methods.name: NoteDetailRoute
methods.description: Main React component rendering the note detail view, sidebar, and editor, managing user interactions.
